title: Part One: Gaza Before the State, and the Refugees

sections.brief: Gaza town and district before 1948: Ottoman sanjak, the 1906 border, the 1917 battles, the Mandate census, the Jewish community to 1929, Kfar Darom. Figures: timeline; stats.
1948 in the south: Kfar Darom, the Egyptian advance, the All-Palestine Government, Operation Yoav, the armistice and the 1950 modus vivendi; how the strip was made. Figures: timeline; comparison.
The refugees: 80,000 residents and 200,000+ refugees, the camps, UNRWA and Res 302, Resolution 194, the Majdal transfer of 1950, Egyptian rule's legal limbo. Figures: stats; money/flow; comparison.
